title: Nursing Today, From the Bedside and Beyond

reader_summary.overview: "Constant attention by a good nurse may be just as important as a major operation by a surgeon”. For most of us, nurses are essentially the face of the healthcare system: the person you’ll see the most of while you’re in it. So in this episode, we take a look at the role of that unsung hero of healthcare -- the nurse -- at an industry level.
